cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cloud rained the letter M onto the lawn. I've approved your plan to make it write 'Marry me' tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It collapsed after one letter. Can we check the full-length test report?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're permitted to start with what worked. Photograph that M; I'll hold the report while you mark out the next letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read 'dissolves after first letter' upside down. Is that why you turned the report over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll discuss that after setting the proposal table. Your M is real. Put her chair beside it; I'll keep the report here while you show her how the first word begins.

reason: Make the current limiting finding explicit to the reader through B's discovery, preserving A's deliberate suppression and specific hope-preserving next action.
